title: Annotatio IV §.III open: Four proofs that John 6 inculcates Spiritual / Supernatural / Celestial Mode
pass_a_gloss: §. III. That the Spiritual, Supernatural, and Celestial Mode of presence alike and of participation of Christ’s body and blood — not any other, certainly not the Corporal, Natural and Earthly — is inculcated by Christ in John 6, is proved by a fourfold argument.
pass_b_english: §.III: four proofs that in John 6 Christ inculcates the Spiritual, Supernatural, Celestial Mode of presence and participation of His body and blood.
Not any other mode — certainly not the Corporal, Natural, Earthly one.
source_text: §. III. Spiritualem, Supernaturalem, Cælestemque Modum præsentiæ pariter atque participationis corporis & sanguinis Christi, non alium quempiam, certè non Corporalem, Naturalem ac Terrestrem, Joh. 6., à Christo inculcari, quadruplici argumento probatur.
notes: §.III open: fourfold proof of spiritual Mode.
